findings.text: after_suite records the default-marker head arm as completed with 71 failed / 8412 passed at revision 386af6310, but the log it cites, logs/gate-head2-default.log, stops at 77% with no summary line and no EXIT= line and its own header command is '-n 4 --basetemp=/dev/shm/39486-fleet-1291586/bt-f1', not the '-n 8 --basetemp=.../bt-h2d' the record states. The done-when's 'zero added failure ids' is therefore evidenced on the graph arm only; the default-marker run must be re-run at the head and its log recorded.

negative_control_log ends at '1 failed, 2 deselected' with no bare EXIT= line, so reckon crew check --manifest reports that whether the control run failed is unknown and refuses the record; the control's substance is sound (the log's AssertionError shows physics_domain None with the isinstance gate restored) and only the exit-status line is missing.

reckon crew check --manifest names nine changed paths outside the write scope and the blockers field requests a grant for six; tests/standard_names/test_edit_engine.py, tests/standard_names/test_refine_source_cohort_gate.py and tests/standard_names/test_graph_edge_writers.py are out of scope and unnamed, so a coordinator granting what the manifest asks for would still leave three files unauthorised.

artifacts cites logs/proxy.log as the head run of the path tests (3 passed), and no such file exists in the run's logs directory; the only path-test log present, logs/path-tests.log, predates the third test at revision 0ba067cc6 (2 passed).

after_graph_suite records revision 386af6310 while the log it cites, logs/gate-head2-graph.log, opens '== head a436958fd ==' and carries no command line near its head, which reckon crew check --manifest also reports; the difference is docs-only in content but the record names a revision the log does not prove.

The query-interface capability check is written inline and duplicates the identical predicate already at imas_codex/standard_names/promote.py:1048 rather than sharing a named predicate; a later change to what counts as a writable client has two sites to keep in step.

item_verdicts.call_sites: Two production call sites reach the changed function and were opened: imas_codex/standard_names/edit.py:3401 and imas_codex/standard_names/worker_tasks/worker_refine_names.py:252.
item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit: de609213c replaces the isinstance gate with a callable query check and drops the dead physics_domain/source_domains parameters, a436958fd answers the writer's state read in nine mock clients and adds the proxy path test, 386af6310 records the change and the gate figures in the evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done-when asks for zero added failure ids on the whole tests/standard_names suite in both marker sets plus per-path tests that fail on revert; the graph arm is recorded and readable (59 failed at head against 60 at base), but the default-marker head arm has no completed log at logs/gate-head2-default.log.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is that every StandardName domain write reachable from the graph-store catalog modules goes through write_name_domain; the increment closes the last gate that could skip it, at graph_refinement.py:1405-1420, and removes the two dead parameter pairs from that function's statements.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it discloses six out-of-scope test files under blockers (manifest.md:25), records both gate arms as completed (manifest.md:19-21), and cites logs/proxy.log under artifacts (manifest.md:22), which does not exist on disk.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The source brief fences seven paths; the increment touches graph_refinement.py, tests/standard_names/test_name_domain_writer_catalog_sites.py and the evidence fragment inside that fence and eight further test files outside it.

justifications.durability: logs/negative-control-isinstance.log shows the added assertion failing with physics_domain None when the isinstance gate is restored, so test_name_domain_writer_catalog_sites.py:222 is a guard rather than a restatement of its input; the edge and source-domain assertions at :225-226 read the graph's HAS_PHYSICS_DOMAIN edges against the node's property, two independent reads.
justifications.evidence: The head default-marker arm is unreadable: logs/gate-head2-default.log stops at 77% with no summary line and no EXIT= line and its own command is -n 4 with basetemp bt-f1, while manifest.md:19 records completed true, 71 failed/8412 passed and a -n 8 bt-h2d command; reckon crew check --manifest reports the same truncation and the missing EXIT on the negative control, and the only readable head arm is -m graph at a436958fd (59 failed against base 60, zero added).
justifications.fit: The capability check at graph_refinement.py:1405 repeats the inline idiom already used at imas_codex/standard_names/promote.py:1048, and the raise happens after tx.commit() at graph_refinement.py:1362 so a bad client leaves a committed successor with no domain and only the exception as the signal.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The three commits since d5c451ae do what they claim: graph_refinement.py:1405-1420 replaces the isinstance gate with a capability check and calls write_name_domain for every client, the TypeError path refuses rather than skips, and no call in the function passes physics_domain or source_domains to a statement any more.
justifications.reuse: The change extends the owner imas_codex/standard_names/domain_decision.py:409 (fallback_domain at :413) rather than forking a second writer; the only capability it re-expresses is the query-interface predicate already written inline at promote.py:1048, with no shared owner to extend.
justifications.scope_discipline: reckon crew check --manifest names nine changed paths outside the fence (test_atomic_refined_name_persistence.py, test_edit_engine.py, test_graph_edge_writers.py, test_minted_name_carries_a_catalog_status.py, test_persist_stages.py, test_refine_name_chain.py, test_refine_source_cohort_gate.py, test_snrun_async_counters.py, test_supersession.py) while manifest.md:25 requests a grant for six of them.
